claims.text: Spectres creep out of nihils from the Tempest and hide in the dark corners of Necropoli, attacking Hierarchy, Heretics and Renegades alike.
They serve Oblivion directly by obeying their Malfean masters and indirectly by destroying souls, using the quarrels of wraith society to lead the Restless away from Transcendence.

title: Mortwights
summary: Souls who become Spectres at the moment of death.

claims.text: A new kind of Spectre now appears more often: souls whose violent or traumatic deaths make them Spectres at once, called Mortwights.
The other Spectre castes rank these casteless newcomers below Doppelgangers, but their numbers and skill in assaults on Stygia may soon force a change; even the Malfeans seem puzzled by them.
